name: GeM (Government e-Marketplace)
description: Online platform for procurement of goods and services by government buyers and selling by sellers/MSMEs.
eligibility: Sellers (including MSMEs) and government buyers; sellers need business registration, bank, tax details.
benefits: Transparent public procurement, direct market access, MSE preference, timely payment.
application_steps: Register as buyer or seller on gem.gov.in.
Transact via bid/RA; order and fulfil.
processing_time: Registration quick; transaction per bid cycle.
fees: No fee for buyers; sellers pay one-time caution money + per-transaction charges per GeM policy.

faq.q: Is GeM only for government buyers?
faq.a: Buyers are government entities; sellers can be any eligible business/MSME.

ai_summary: GeM is the national public procurement portal connecting government buyers with sellers/MSMEs.
ai_explanation: GeM is an open e-marketplace where government departments buy goods/services and businesses (including MSMEs) sell. It brings transparency, MSE preferences, and faster payments. Sellers register with business and tax details and list catalogues.
